question: Rashtriya Sanskrit Vidhyapeetha, Tirupati elevated to the status of a Central University in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rashtriya Sanskrit Vidyapeetha, Tirupati was elevated to the status of a Central University in 2020.
 
• This significant development occurred through the passage of the Central Sanskrit Universities Act, 2020 by the Indian Parliament. This Act granted central university status to three institutions:
